newsitem.title: USA: DentlCare buys Chicago Denture Clinic.
newsitem.headline: DentlCare buys Chicago Denture Clinic.

text.p: Dentlcare Management Inc and its affiliated professional corporation said Wednesday it completed the acquisition of the Chicago Denture Clinic for undisclosed terms.
It said Chicago Denture Clinic reported more than $500,000 in gross sales for 1996 and expects revenues to exceed $1 million in 1997.
Chicago Denture, established in 1947, provides general dental services with emphasis on prosthetics.
DentlCare Management is a dental practice management company that has developed models for creation and management of high volume dental practices.
